announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results follow the September completion of acquisitions. Shareholders should watch for performance details of the newly acquired assets.

announcements.headline: Technical Cooperation Agreement
announcements.insight: Harvest Minerals Limited has entered a technical cooperation agreement following its recent acquisition of the Brazilian Rare Earth Portfolio and completion of Scanty Mineracao & TVR.

announcements.headline: Results of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow the completed acquisitions of Scanty Mineracao & TVR and the Brazilian Rare Earth Portfolio.

announcements.headline: Completed acquisition of Scanty Mineracao & TVR
announcements.insight: Harvest Minerals Limited completed its acquisition of a Brazilian Rare Earth Portfolio in July. This finalizes the strategic move announced earlier that month.

announcements.headline: Acquisition of Brazilian Rare Earth Portfolio
announcements.insight: Harvest Minerals Limited acquires a Brazilian Rare Earth Portfolio. This follows its 2025 Final Results in June 2026.

announcements.headline: 2025 Final Results
announcements.insight: Harvest Minerals Limited has released its 2025 final results. Shareholders should review these figures for performance indicators.
